welcome_page.title: Walking – Road safety
welcome_page.image_alt: #Person walking and a route between two points
welcome_page.description:
Traffic, crossings, sidewalks and obstacles when you walk. Each question has two answers: Yes or No.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name. Giving your email is optional; the SmartUrbanity privacy notice explains how it is protected and how answers are used.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

questions.text: When you walk along roads with fast or heavy traffic, do you feel unsafe?
When you cross roads with fast or heavy traffic on foot, do you feel unsafe?
Do you avoid some roads or crossings because you cannot cross them safely on foot?
While walking, do you feel unsafe when cyclists or e-scooter riders pass close to you?
While walking, do poor sidewalk conditions (e.g., holes, uneven surfaces, or crumbling edges) make you feel unsafe?
Do obstacles on the sidewalk (e.g., roadworks, bins, or parked scooters) force you to change your path or walk closer to traffic?
When you walk, who on the road makes you feel unsafe? (Select all that apply)
When you walk, which of these situations make you feel unsafe? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Unsafe behaviour from drivers, riders or pedestrians
Crowding or conflicts with other road users
Lack of safe or adequate sidewalks, crossings or lighting

questions.text: Which of these do you find on your walking route? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Steps or steep curbs without ramps
Dropped kerbs at crossings missing or broken
Paths too narrow for a wheelchair, pushchair or two people to pass
Tactile paving for people with visual impairments missing or broken
Low branches or bushes taking up space
Stairs as the only way through, or stairways closed
Stretches with no sidewalk, so you have to walk in the road
Pedestrian traffic lights out of order

it.#<p>Traffic, crossings, sidewalks and ob:
Traffico, attraversamenti, marciapiedi e ostacoli quando cammini. Ogni domanda ha due risposte: Sì o No.

La partecipazione è volontaria e puoi saltare qualsiasi domanda. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome. Lasciare l'email è facoltativo; l'informativa sulla privacy di SmartUrbanity spiega come viene protetta e come vengono usate le risposte.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity

fr.#<p>Traffic, crossings, sidewalks and ob:
La circulation, les passages piétons, les trottoirs et les obstacles lorsque vous marchez. Chaque question a deux réponses : Oui ou Non.

de.#<p>Traffic, crossings, sidewalks and ob:
Verkehr, Überwege, Gehwege und Hindernisse, wenn Sie zu Fuß unterwegs sind. Jede Frage hat zwei Antworten: Ja oder Nein.

fa.#When you walk along roads with fast or: وقتی در امتداد خیابان‌هایی با ترافیک سریع یا سنگین راه می‌روید، احساس ناامنی می‌کنید؟

fa.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: پاسخ شما ثبت شد. از وقتی که برای تکمیل این پرسشنامه گذاشتید سپاسگزاریم.
fa.#<p>Traffic, crossings, sidewalks and ob:
ترافیک، گذرگاه‌ها، پیاده‌روها و موانع هنگام پیاده‌روی. هر پرسش دو پاسخ دارد: بله یا خیر.

شرکت در این پرسشنامه داوطلبانه است و می‌توانید به هر پرسشی پاسخ ندهید. پاسخ‌های شما به نام شما مرتبط نمی‌شوند. وارد کردن ایمیل اختیاری است؛ بیانیه حریم خصوصی SmartUrbanity توضیح می‌دهد ایمیل چگونه محافظت می‌شود و پاسخ‌ها چگونه استفاده می‌شوند.
